messages:
kat: Drafting a short plan for a microburst protection rollout (feature-flagged). Focus: avoid regional blowups during sudden traffic spikes while preserving enterprise SLAs.

oliver: Quick alignment ask: is this primarily an autoscale/backpressure feature or model-quality degrade?

kat: Both. Start with routing-level backpressure + light model degrade for best-effort tenants. Enterprise tenants are exempt by default.

priya: SRE wants concrete triggers: if region QPS spikes > 3x baseline for 3m OR queue depth > 80% for 2m -> engage microburst policy.

oncall-bot: oncall-bot: alert-policy updated: microburst-qps-threshold set to 3x for region.

oliver: Rollout stages: 1) shadow 12h -> 2) micro canary (0.5% tenants) 1h -> 3) 2% for 4h -> 4) 10% for 12h -> 5) enable by policy. Each stage gated by: latency_95 < 1.25x AND mismatch_rate < 1%.

kat: Feature flag needs: scope=tenant,region; exempt_list for enterprise tenants; TTLed exemptions for trial customers; org kill-switch. Also require two approvers to bump >2% region weight.

priya: Fallbacks: primary = route to cached-response path with short TTL; secondary = quantized model variant. If both fail, shed low-priority requests with 503 and contextual message.

oliver: Measurement: sample 1% requests for A/B evaluation; compute semantic similarity + token delta. Gate if mismatch > 1.5% on protected prompts.

kat: Runbook (short): ACK alert -> confirm trigger -> flip flag to shadow-> if persistent, enable micro canary -> monitor 15m -> kill-switch if regressions -> notify CS -> postmortem 72h.

priya: CS action: provide customer-safe notification wording and opt-out flow.

kat: Action items: kat to author rollout doc, oliver to add flag PR, priya to finalize runbook and thresholds. Please drop links here by EOD.

oliver: PR will be up by EOD.

priya: Runbook draft tomorrow morning.

kat: thanks. looping in @ops on follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
